content.caption:
"That’s the night shift. We work the day shift."

Most of us grew up thinking mosquitoes only attack after sunset. But right now in Hyderabad, daytime bites are at their peak. The mosquitoes that can spread dengue bite mostly during daylight hours and love breeding in fresh, standing water inside our homes.

Take two minutes today to check your indoor plant trays, AC runoff, and balcony buckets. Emptying standing water once a week breaks their cycle before they can fly.
